crossRefs.note: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”
translations.bsb: “I have sinned,” Saul replied. “Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel. Come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God.”
translations.kjv: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honor me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah thy God.
